notes.title: Out There: Oceans of Time RedShift Update Available Now!
notes.notes:
Redshift update is now live with 20% off for a limited time only! It's the perfect time to venture further Out There. And for our veteran adventurers, have no fear, you can continue playing your old save by switching to the previous version of the game through the Beta tab on Steam.

We listened to your all feedback and this new update lands with significant improvements to the game for an even better experience! 

[previewyoutube=FpUK1BForIg;full][/previewyoutube]

Redshift update includes:
💫 New Oxygen management system on Rocky Planets Expeditions
💫 New class skills
💫 New Consumable Items
💫 New maps for all expedition types
💫 New way to explore maps (Tunnels, Ancient Portals, and Unstable Structures)
💫 Overall difficulty balancing 
💫 New UI to follow your exploration
💫 New save system with multiple endings  
💫 Text Adventures balancing
💫 Spaceships balancing

Take some time to explore the galaxy like never before and travel the cosmos!

Until next time, we'll see you Out There.

- Mi-Clos & Modern Wolf

notes.title: End of the Redshift Beta... Time for the Redshift update!
notes.notes:
The Out There: Oceans of Time Redshift Beta is coming to an end, and we're closing out with some big news: we're happy to announce that we'll be rolling out the Redshift update on October 13th!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35677524/65f7d852525b7778b2a44f33263b1e707d75648d.png

When Out There: Oceans of Time was released last May, we listened closely to feedback - both positive and negative - and have taken it all into account with the Redshift update.

Thank you to everyone who participated in the Beta and for supporting us in making changes that will be implemented in the full Redshift release. 

Thanks to all of your fantastic feedback, we've been able to refine the game based on your feedback during the beta period, but we will keep listening to our community once the patch is deployed.

Happy exploring, travelers!

notes.title: Playtest the huge new Out There: Oceans of Time 1.2 Update on September 7!
notes.notes:
Since the release of Out There: Oceans of Time, we have been working hard to prepare our biggest update to the game to date; a huge 1.2 featuring a complete overhaul of Expeditions and a full rebalancing of the game. 

We want the game to be the best it can be, and to achieve that, we’re bringing you into the heart of the process.

We've listened to your feedback, notes and suggestions, and have reworked the game to meet your ongoing expectations. 

You will experience a taste of these reworks during an exclusive test phase next week, taking the form of a private playtest. For those of you that own the game already, details om how to access the playtest will be shared on September 7th. 

Questions? We’ve got answers!

* Who is the playtest for?
All players who already have the game in their Steam library will be able to access the 1.2 Update branch. 

* What does the playtest involve?
The playtest will offer up the brand new Expedition system, in addition to a rehauled and rebalanced version of the game. 

* How?
Unlike starting a fresh game, you won’t start at the beginning of the story, but further into the journey, with a pre-defined crew and cargo. 

* Why?
The objective of the test is to get your feedback and feelings in order to validate and finalize the latest changes to the game before they’re rolled out. This is a unique chance for you to participate in the finalization of the game; we’re very excited to hear your thoughts, feedback and comments. 

* When?
Get your diary! On September 7th the playtest branch will open its doors to all players. 

--

notes.title: Update 1.1.0 is live!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, we are aware of the performance issues that the game is currently experiencing.
We are actively working on it to fix these issues as soon as possible. In the meantime, the vertical sync has been automatically activated which will help optimise the game.

Many of you are wondering about the withdrawal of stamina compared to the Beta.
We invite you to read this post if you want to have more information :
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1145290/discussions/0/3382779373367250376/

In this second patch:


 Fixed several buttons to skip content not working as intended
 Fixed several text events requiring the wrong class
 Removed already acquired blueprints from trade
 Fixed several UI bugs related to the botanical complex
 Fixed several bugs when playing the Simplified Chinese version of the game
 Balanced trading
 Balanced ships specs
 Balanced material required to build technologies and modules
 Balanced technologies and modules effects
 Fixed “Trade” button not working or triggering bugs
 Fixed button to travel to back to Nebula's Epsilon system after leaving
 Fixed several general UI bugs
 Crew member now re-assign automatically when switching ship or rebuilding a technology
 VSync enabled by default


There's much more to come. Thank you for your patience and please remember you can report issues on both our discord and on our Steam forums. 

- Mi-Clos Studios & Modern Wolf

notes.title: Out There: Oceans of Time has a new release date of May 26th, 2022.
notes.notes:
Today, as part of The MIX 10th Anniversary Showcase, Modern Wolf and Mi-Clos Studios unveiled a brand new cinematic trailer for Out There: Oceans of Time, revealing a new release date for the game of May 26th, 2022. 

[previewyoutube=-iM0gHti3_M;full][/previewyoutube]

The successor to the award-winning Out There, Oceans of Time blends roguelike, resource management and interactive fiction for a space survival epic where death is one wrong decision away. As Commander Nyx, you’ll explore a vast galaxy that is different every time you play, as you search for the Archon; a cosmic villain set on dominating the civilisations of the galaxy.

Alongside polish and bug-fixing, the new release date of May 26 allows for significant improvements to the game, whilst ensuring that the Mi-Clos Studios team does not need to crunch or risk burnout to make the original date happen. 

While this is frustrating for fans - who we know are desperate to begin their journeys - this ensures that Out There: Oceans of Time is delivering the best experience possible to both long time fans, and new players alike. 

Keep up to date with Out There: Oceans of Time
